overview.description: The MFS Blended Research Core Equity ETF (BRCE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that targets large-cap US equity securities based on fundamental and quantitative research. BRCE was launched on Oct 22, 2025 and is issued by MFS.
